uq_autonomy_event_one_action.name: uq_autonomy_event_one_action
uq_autonomy_event_one_action.where: entry_kind = 'action' and record is not null

autonomy_event_entry_fields.name: autonomy_event_entry_fields
autonomy_event_entry_fields.value:
(entry_kind = 'action' and kind is not null and subject is not null
            and why is not null and witness is not null)
        or (entry_kind = 'steer' and steer is not null and why is null and witness is null)

codex_supersession_mode.name: codex_supersession_mode
codex_supersession_mode.value: mode is null or mode in ('plan', 'review')

codex_supersession_wording_shape.name: codex_supersession_wording_shape
codex_supersession_wording_shape.value: kind <> 'wording' or (property_id is not null and pass is null and mode is null and branch is null)

codex_supersession_no_tree_shape.name: codex_supersession_no_tree_shape
codex_supersession_no_tree_shape.value: kind <> 'no-tree' or (pass is not null and mode is not null and branch is not null)

content_github_bot_read.name: content_github_bot_read
content_github_bot_read.using: exists (select 1 from content c where c.id = content_id and c.visibility = 'public')

content_linear_bot_read.name: content_linear_bot_read
content_linear_bot_read.using: exists (select 1 from content c where c.id = content_id and c.visibility = 'public')

content_notion_bot_read.name: content_notion_bot_read
content_notion_bot_read.using: exists (select 1 from content c where c.id = content_id and c.visibility = 'public')

content_slack_bot_read.name: content_slack_bot_read
content_slack_bot_read.using: exists (select 1 from content c where c.id = content_id and c.visibility = 'public')

idx_content_parent_unresolved.name: idx_content_parent_unresolved
idx_content_parent_unresolved.where: parent_id is null and parent_source_id is not null

fleet_journal_event_placeholder_is_impor.name: fleet_journal_event_placeholder_is_imported
fleet_journal_event_placeholder_is_impor.value: event IS NOT NULL OR import_line IS NOT NULL

generated.as:
to_tsvector(
        'english',
        domain || ' ' || claim || ' ' || evidence || ' ' || coalesce(caveat, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(behaviour_change, '') || ' ' || coalesce(retrieval_cue, '')
      )

memories_kind_facets.name: memories_kind_facets
memories_kind_facets.value:
(kind::text = 'lesson' and tier is not null and surface is not null
          and question is null and outcome is null)
        or (kind::text = 'preference' and tier is null and surface is null and repro is null
          and question is null and outcome is null)
        or (kind::text = 'trace' and tier is null and surface is null and repro is not null
          and question is not null and outcome is not null
          and (outcome::text = 'paid' or caveat is not null))

memories_tier_range.name: memories_tier_range
memories_tier_range.value: tier is null or (tier >= 1 and tier <= 4)

org_health_acknowledgement_marker_shape.name: org_health_acknowledgement_marker_shape
org_health_acknowledgement_marker_shape.value: (id = 'legacy-v1' AND kind = 'legacy-import' AND document IS NULL) OR (id <> 'legacy-v1' AND kind = 'acknowledgement' AND document IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(document) = 'object')

owner_voice_register_non_negative.name: owner_voice_register_non_negative
owner_voice_register_non_negative.value:
(median_words is null or median_words >= 0)
        and (p75_words is null or p75_words >= 0)
        and (p90_words is null or p90_words >= 0)
        and (ceiling_words is null or ceiling_words >= 0)
        and (sample_count is null or sample_count >= 0)

store_import_question_kind.name: store_import_question_kind
store_import_question_kind.value: (kind = 'activation' and live_summary is null) or (kind = 'conflict' and live_summary is not null)

store_import_resolution_action.name: store_import_resolution_action
store_import_resolution_action.value: (question_kind = 'activation' and action in ('activate', 'leave-inactive')) or (question_kind = 'conflict' and action in ('keep-current', 'take-imported'))
